window_rule: every target day and both buffers qualify, and the whole window stays inside one role
selection_rule: earliest-first, non-overlapping supports per station and duration, so no two episodes share target or buffer days; the emitted count equals the delivered support_nonoverlap
mask_rule: one whole-day mask per episode covering only legal slots, with one shared mask_id for HA, mu-only, basis-only and mu+projection
forbidden: relaxing the threshold to obtain episodes
boundary: the census reads published per-station-day counts; no released daily array is opened and no Test value enters any fit, so Test rows are enumerated from counts only

digests.input_sha256: digest of the episode's released source arrays; a Test episode needs the gate open
digests.scoring_sha256: digest of the scoring support actually used by the run
digests.reference_sha256: digest of the reference support actually scored against
digests.why: these are array-level digests; inventing them before the run would break the chain

freeze: the formal bank stays pending until the owner freezes the release; this policy is candidate bound
